author: deweybigpont
quote: A step back in everything except graphics. Boring, punishingly slow gameplay, sluggish controls and framerate,  dull unlikeable protagonists and npcs, vapid millenial writing and dialogue that tries so hard to be funny and fails on every level, numerous bugs, the list goes on. Don't believe the so called "professional critics" they are clearly in Rockstar's/Take-two's pocket.
